coverage_by_ac.test: FF-1: Handle identity-only shape (no data/fields/payload/view/snapshot member; frozen)

FF-2: Opacity nominal brand (isObjectHandle discriminates; brand not forgeable via Symbol.for/string-key) + tsc @ts-expect-error fixture. COVERAGE GAP (R-4): the brand is set ENUMERABLE, so a spread-clone `{...handle}` copies it and passes isObjectHandle while being mutable — a record .data accessor can then be attached and rides past assertVariableValue. No test asserts brand non-enumerability / spread-clone rejection; the nominal-opacity invariant AC-2 asserts is broken in-memory.
FF-3: assertVariableValue rejects record-ref + payload, record-kind ref, data/fields/payload/view objects, nested in array/object
FF-4: denyAllResolver fails closed (denied:true, reason no_grant, never fields) for any subject incl. privileged
FF-5: makeHandle reference-only, deterministic handleId, no field reveal

FF-6 + FF-9-R3: makeHandle tenant-bound, cross-tenant => CrossTenantHandleError; R-3 RESOLVED (4df5c4b) — parseHandle now routes through makeHandle and rejects a cross-tenant wire ref (record/registry/application) with CrossTenantHandleError, at parity with construction. Re-verified live (rt-choros 2026-06-10).

FF-7 / FF-9 / FF-9-AC7: serialize/parse round-trip identity (well-formed handles, all 3 ref kinds × ±facet); serialized form has only identity keys. Re-verified live: honest round-trip identity-preserving, no regression after R-2/R-3 hardening.
FF-8: single chokepoint — no .data/.fields/.payload accessor; denyAllResolver only exported resolver
FF-A3 lint object-handle-isolation.sh: no forbidden imports, frozen files unmodified
AC-10 static-now: object_handle in known_tenant_tables fixture, no payload column

secondary_ux.check: none — pure-TS authority core, no web UX surface

failures.test: RESOLVED. parseHandle now routes facet through validateAndReconstructFacet() (rejects any key != `fields`, non-array fields, non-string elements). Re-verified live (rt-choros 2026-06-10): the R-2 repro `facet:{fields:['a'],data:{ssn}}` now throws MalformedHandleError; honest `{fields:[...]}` facet still round-trips. Covered by FF-9-R2 block in src/__tests__/object-handle.test.ts.

RESOLVED. parseHandle now feeds validated (ref,tenantId,facet) into makeHandle, inheriting the cross-tenant check. Re-verified live (rt-choros 2026-06-10): the R-3 repro (wire ref.tenantId != envelope tenantId) now throws CrossTenantHandleError at parity with makeHandle, for all three ref kinds. Covered by FF-9-R3 block.

MISSING (no test exists). The runtime brand `_RUNTIME_BRAND` is set ENUMERABLE (Object.assign), so it is copied by object spread / Object.assign. A spread-clone of a genuine handle still passes isObjectHandle while being mutable; a record `.data` accessor can then be attached and rides past assertVariableValue (brand short-circuit, line 526). Defeats the in-memory opacity edge (AC-2/FR-2) and contradicts the brand's own 'un-forgeable outside this module' contract. Repro (verified live, rt-choros 2026-06-10): const h=makeHandle({kind:'record',tenantId:T,registryId:T,recordId:T},T); const forged={...h}; forged.data={ssn:'123-45-6789'}; isObjectHandle(forged)===true; assertVariableValue(forged)==={ok:true}. Fix: make the brand non-enumerable (Object.defineProperty enumerable:false) — locally-verified to make `{...h}` fail isObjectHandle while genuine handles still pass; round-trip unaffected (serializeHandle reads named props, not via enumeration). Add an FF-9 test for spread-clone rejection.

blocked_reason: R-4 (blocking): enumerable runtime brand is copyable by object spread, forging a payload-capable pseudo-handle that passes isObjectHandle and assertVariableValue — opacity bypass outside the parse⊆make generalization. Fix = non-enumerable brand.
